subject: math

objective.text: See how squares make a cube. Count a cube's faces, edges and corners.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective: Relate the square to the cube, and describe the cube based on attributes.

explanations.title: A cube has square faces
explanations.text: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 square corners. A cube is a solid shape. Its faces are squares.

explanations.title: Build a cube from a square
explanations.text: Start with a square of 4 toothpicks. Add toothpicks up and across. Now you have a skeleton cube.

explanations.title: Draw a cube
explanations.text: Draw a square. Draw a line above it. Make a square corner. Join the corners. You see 3 faces.

examples.title: Counting a cube's edges
examples.text: Count the bottom: 4 edges. Count the middle: 4 more, so 8. Count the top: 4 more. That makes 12 edges.
